field_of_view_deg: Panorama: 360 horizontal x 111 vertical; PTZ: 61.8 (W) to 2.2 (T) horizontal
features: two built-in GPUs for deep-learning analysis
AR panorama: stitch to 360 view + clickable camera tags (linked video)
intelligent tracking: panorama detects, PTZ tracks + captures detail
IVS perimeter detection: tripwire crossing, intrusion, parking detection
IR illuminator to 400 m (light compensation up to 400 m), 7 IR LEDs
PTZ: pan 0-360, tilt -11 to +90, 300 presets, 8 tour paths, auto-tracking (5)
audio: 2 in / 2 out (wiring terminal), 1 analog CVBS out (BNC)
RS-485, 7 alarm inputs / 3 outputs, gigabit Ethernet
release_notes: Specs extracted from the official HOLOWITS U9-9(40x)A-P360 AI datasheet (only a reseller-CDN copy was available); source URL omitted per project rule (non-official host). 8-sensor panorama + PTZ combo, typed panoramic.
